acceptance: A staged change with one function below 100% coverage is refused by the commit gate through the real entry point
The test is red before the build
A plumbing fault in the coverage read gives a warning and does not refuse the commit
fix: Add -coverprofile with the integration tag to the go test of the Go lane in go/internal/commitgate/lanes.go. Then call covchanged.Workspace.Check with base HEAD and covchanged.DefaultTags. Keep a plumbing fault as a warning, not a refusal.
summary: Decision D2 of docs/plans/cover-changed-gate-2026-10.md says the Go lane of the commit gate must call Workspace.Check with base HEAD. go/internal/commitgate has no reference to covchanged. The go test call at go/internal/commitgate/lanes.go:145 runs no coverage profile. CI and the loop build floor enforce the gate. A console commit does not. So a console PR goes red in CI after the push. That wastes a CI run and a fix round.
title: The Go lane of the commit gate runs cover changed on the staged diff
